Stunning visual shows illuminate the huge LED dome, forming a sensational backdrop for concerts, discos and parties. In fact, there’s always something beautiful to do in the World Galleria, under a spectacular digital sky.Dolce Vita BarThere is a whole world of choice waiting to be discovered on MSC World Europa, ensuring guests will never be short of options for a delicious beverage or a tasty treat with friends and family.MSC Luna Park Arena​At MSC Luna Park Arena anything can happen. This 300-seat studio theatre will host a wide variety of entertainment day and night, from cinema experiences to live shows and late-night parties. It’s a multifunctional venue designed to adapt to any performance or event, changing chameleon-like for each one.​MSC Luna Park Arena​​At MSC Luna Park Arena anything can happen. This 300-seat studio theatre will host a wide variety of entertainment day and night, from cinema experiences to live shows and late-night parties. It’s a multifunctional venue designed to adapt to any performance or event, changing chameleon-like for each one.​​Panorama Lounge​This exciting live entertainment venue will host a series of different shows each night, including flying aerial displays, live music and specialist acts featuring multi-skilled performers.​MSC ShopIn addition to sun, sea and sand, Ocean Cay also provides various shopping options. Exclusive gifts and souvenirs inspired by the beautiful island can be found at the Ocean Cay Trading Post.​ Get all you need for a great day on the island at the MSC Shop and support good causes with our selection of MSC Foundation items.​LighthouseAt 100 feet, the red and white lighthouse is a striking landmark and a useful orientation point. ​It is also home to a Hemingway-style bar and a terrace.​Masters of the Sea​Guests will discover a lovely spot to savour a beer in a perfect Englishstyle pub: The Masters of the Sea will feature our new microbrewery at sea and will serve the very first signature beer exclusively crafted on board MSC World Europa.​Hola! Tacos & CantinaAt the family-style restaurant HOLA! Tacos & Cantina, guests can enjoy a variety of specialities inspired by Mexican street food and other Latin American culinary traditions. There is also an extensive list of tequilas and mezcals to choose from. And it’s all served up in fun, interactive setting that will be popular with guests of all ages.Savour MSC Yacht Club seclusion on Ocean Cay ​Tucked away in a quiet spot in the northwest of Ocean Cay lies an exclusive, special beach area reserved only for MSC Yacht Club guests.​ A short path leads to the beach where guests can enjoy sunbeds and cabanas* with butler service in an oasis of tranquillity.​MSC Yacht Club guests can enjoy privacy and luxury from ship to shore.​Ocean House BeachOcean House Beach, exclusive to our MSC Yacht Club guests, offers an upscale experience like no other. MSC Yacht Club guests can enjoy private amenities on the island, including a private bar to quench your thirst on a hot Bahamian day, or rent a Beachfront or Ocean View Cabana for the day.​Ocean HouseFor guests seeking privacy and exclusivity, this premium, all-inclusive,​ colonial-style Ocean House is a great place to relax, sip a cocktail​ and enjoy a gourmet meal.​Incredible Innovations for even Greater ComfortThe ship’s beautiful design features also enhance guests’ experience: the plumb bow maximises comfort, the Y-shaped aft greatly increases the number of balcony cabins, and the Venom Drop @ The Spiral dry slide gives guests a fast and fun way to reach the lower decks. Destined to become one of the most photographed features on the ship, it is a sleek, stainless steel dry slide that with its 74,6 meter length is the longest anywhere at sea.​La Pescaderia - Fish Market"For those who prefer the perfectly grilled fish dishes, variety of mezze and other seafood specialties, La Pescaderia - Fish Market is the place to go. Boasting a spacious al fresco dining area, this casual eatery provides guest the opportunity to appreciate "fruits from the ocean" while enjoying invigorating views and breathing the exhilarating sea air.​"Coffee EmporiumAmong the brand new bar and lounge concepts created specifically for this latest MSC Cruises flagship, guests will enjoy discovering daytime venues like the Coffee Emporium - an immersive coffee journey where the highest-quality coffee beans sourced from around the world and artfully prepared by our passionate baristas.​Ocean HouseFor guests seeking privacy and exclusivity, this premium, all-inclusive,​ colonial-style Ocean House is a great place to relax, sip a cocktail​ and enjoy a gourmet meal.​Ocean HouseFor guests seeking privacy and exclusivity, this premium, all-inclusive,​ colonial-style Ocean House is a great place to relax, sip a cocktail​ and enjoy a gourmet meal.​Raj Polo Tea HouseAmong the brand new bar and lounge concepts created specifically for this latest MSC Cruises flagship, guests will enjoy discovering daytime venues like the Raj Polo Tea House, a haven the sophisticated tea lovers and the curious to explore and enjoy traditional afternoon tea with elegant service. Complete the evening with tea cocktails and paired aperitifs.The Gin ProjectThere is also a variety of new evening haunts to discover, such as The Gin Project, where guests can create their own personal mix.Chef’s Garden KitchenAmong the appealing new dining concepts on board is the Chef’s Garden Kitchen. This fashionable venue features refined dishes garnished with fresh, flavourful microgreens. Leading the culinary creativity, this farm to ocean table restaurant is sure to impress even the discerning palates. With an open kitchen allows guest to partake in the experience and surrounded by first at sea hydroponic micro greenery.Botanic Garden PoolThe Botanic Garden Pool with retractable roof, pool, whirlpool, tropical bar and area for lounging is the place to be for laying back and relaxing at all times of the day.​La PlageIf your idea of holiday heaven is soaking up the sun, taking a refreshing swim and then relaxing poolside, then MSC World Europa is the ultimate destination.Ocean HouseFor guests seeking privacy and exclusivity, this premium, all-inclusive,​ colonial-style Ocean House is a great place to relax, sip a cocktail​ and enjoy a gourmet meal.​Baby Club ChiccoThe Baby Club Chicco provides facilities for babies and toddlers under 3 years old.​Lego RoomExciting new spaces include the exclusive-to-MSC LEGO® Room, open to kids and parents, offering never-ending fun with LEGO bricks.​MSC SportplexThe multi-purpose MSC Sportplex hosts sports tournaments, bumper cars, rollerblading, pickleball, hoverboards, zorb ball… and much, much more, all to be discovered.​Aurora Borealis AquaparkLooking for a bit more excitement? Water is a key part of the onboard experience, and kids will be happy to spend hours playing in the Aquapark. There’s even a dedicated pool for toddlers. The state-of-the-art Aurora Borealis Aquapark boasts four water slides, towering way above the deck and fitted with virtual reality technology to make every run even more exciting.​Ocean HouseFor
